params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

items.docs: This API operation retrieves detailed information about a specific component within a Bitbucket repository's issue tracking system. By providing the workspace identifier, repository slug, and component ID in the endpoint path, users can fetch metadata and configuration details for that particular component, which is typically used to categorize and organize issues within the repository.
